JUDGMENT

The 1st appellant/respondent has filed this Civil Miscellaneous Appeal against the fair and decretal order 19.03.2015 made in M.C.O.P.No.44 of 2014 by the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Kumbakonam.

sentences.text: 2. Pending appeals, the parties have entered into a settlement and the terms of joint compromise memo has been reduced into writing and both the parties as well as their respective counsel signed the compromise.

( Uploaded on: 06/11/2025 05:15:02 pm )
3.The parties are also present before this Court and they have affirmed the compromise memo,
wherein, the respondents / petitioners have agreed to receive a sum of Rs.45,000/- (Rupees Forty Five Thousand only) in addition to the award amount of Rs.2,00,000/-
(Rupees Two Lakhs only) already deposited in the lower Court by the 1 st appellant/respondent with accrued interest in full quit towards their claim from the appellants.

4.The compromise memo filed by the parties dated 06.11.2025, is as follows:
The respondents 2 to 5 being the legal representatives of the 1st respondent who along with his wife the 2nd respondent have filed application claiming compensation for the death of their son a victim to the accident.
The 1st respondent died after the trial court passed award against the 1st respondent/respondent.

The respondent Ganesan aggrieved against the order passed by the trial court preferred appeal in C.M.A.(MD) No.1277 of 2015 before Hon'ble Madurai Bench of Madras High Court and who died subsequently and his L.Rs are the appellants herein and pending the appeal both the parties to the appeal have arrived at a compromise as such the respondents in the appeal are willing to receive a sum of Rs.45,000/- in addition to the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

award amount of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees Two lakhs only) already deposited in the Lower Court by the appellant/ respondent with accrued interest in full quit towards their claim from the appellants.
5. During pendency of the case, the 4th appellant namely, Sriram became major, his date of birth is 13.08.2004, to that effect a memo is filed.
Sriram 4th appellant is also present before this Court.
The memo dated 06.11.2025 is recorded.
